svg.title: Placeholder artwork for Early Voting (in person): a typographic plate, not a photograph
svg.desc: A warm paper plate carrying the event name "Early Voting (in person)" and the date 19 - 31 OCTOBER 2026. It stands in for artwork that does not exist yet and must be replaced with a real photograph.
